messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: skyline tool store link is not working
parts:
You can install MSstats in R from bioconductor.
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("MSstats")
library(MSstats)


However, if you want to use MSstats in skyline, you need to install from skyline tool store. Sorry for inconvenience.

- Meena
